verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rippling supports federated identity across protocols, including OIDC and custom SAML/SCIM apps. That is a protocol-level capability for custom app setups, which is the opposite of the pre-built catalog the story asks for. Nothing in the pack documents a catalog of pre-built SAML/OIDC integrations, its size, or connect-in-minutes setup. App Shop OAuth partner apps are a developer API mechanism, not an SSO catalog.
